title: Automotive Wind Noise Testing
seoDescription: GRAS surface microphones for automotive wind noise and aeroacoustic testing in wind tunnels and on vehicles, including the UTP 48LX series.

props.title: Automotive Wind Noise Testing
paragraphs: Aeroacoustics studies noise generated by turbulent fluid motion or by aerodynamic forces acting on surfaces. It matters in the design of vehicles, aircraft, wind turbines, buildings and bridges, and it is a critical part of automotive design, certification and operation.

Two sources matter: external noise and aerodynamic (pseudo) noise. Wind tests are expensive and slow, and calculation is hard to make realistic because of boundary layer pressure variations, so measurement with surface microphones is key.
